forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M1MP3H7NCNK2GBQ4HR91KA2S
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9080'
+title: 'doctor checks: the sandbox, the tools, the skills and the Metal runtime'
+---
+### What
+
+cli-plan.md §5.12, rows 4 to 7. Two `Doctorable` conformances in
+`Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Doctor/`.
+
+**`ToolsDoctor`**, category `tools`:
+
+- The `sandbox` section: the seatbelt sandbox starts. Run one trivial
+  confined command and report the result. A failure is an `.error`.
+- Each `sandbox.extraWritePaths` entry exists. A missing path is a
+  `.warning` that names it.
+- The `tools.shell` store directory is writable. `nil` means the
+  capability's own default location, and that is checked too.
+- Each configured MCP server: a stdio server's command exists and
+  starts; an http server's URL answers a request. A failure is an
+  `.error` naming the server. `tools.mcp` disabled makes this part
+  contribute nothing.
+- Each disabled tool section is reported as `.ok` with the word
+  "disabled", so a person sees why a tool is absent.
+
+**`RuntimeDoctor`**, category `runtime`:
+
+- The Metal shader library stands beside the binary. This is the failure
+  that the test bootstrap already works around, and a person running the
+  installed binary gets no such help.
+- The skills stack is found.
+
+Every subprocess and every request is behind a timeout, and a timeout is
+a `.warning` with the reason. `doctor` must never hang.
+
+- [ ] `ToolsDoctor`: sandbox, extra paths, shell store, MCP servers
+- [ ] `RuntimeDoctor`: Metal library, skills stack
+- [ ] A disabled section reports `.ok` and says "disabled"
+- [ ] Register both in the doctor component list
+
+### Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] With the default roster and a working machine, every row is `.ok`.
+- [ ] A missing `extraWritePaths` entry gives one `.warning` naming it.
+- [ ] An MCP server whose command does not exist gives one `.error`
+      naming the server and the command.
+- [ ] `tools.shell: false` gives one `.ok` row that says disabled, and
+      no store-directory check.
+- [ ] No check waits longer than its timeout.
+
+### Tests
+
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/Doctor/ToolsDoctorTests.swift`:
+      the missing extra path, the unwritable store directory, and a
+      disabled section.
+- [ ] The MCP check takes an injected prober, so tests drive the
+      found, missing and timeout cases with no real subprocess.
+- [ ] `RuntimeDoctorTests`: the library-present and library-absent
+      cases, against a temporary directory.
+- [ ] A timeout test asserts a `.warning` and no hang.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+### Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
